# Best Choice Counselling

> > Professional mental health services in Calgary offering therapy, psychological assessments, and counselling by experienced registered psychologists and certified counsellors.

Best Choice Counselling is a Calgary-based mental health clinic providing comprehensive psychological services including individual therapy, couples counselling, trauma-informed care, and assessments. The clinic offers direct billing with major Canadian insurance providers and maintains a team of highly credentialed professionals with specialized expertise in various therapeutic approaches.

## Key Topics

- Registered Psychologist
- Calgary Therapy
- Mental Health Services
- Trauma-Informed Care
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy)
- Direct Billing
- Psychological Assessments
- Couples Counselling
- ADHD Assessments
- Anxiety Treatment
- Free Consultation
- Alberta Blue Cross
- SunLife Insurance
- Trauma Therapy
